title: Set 120

sentences.ko: 건조기 고치는 법 찾아보려고 앉았거든. 찾긴 진짜 찾았어. 근데 유튜브가 웬 아저씨가 낡은 트레일러 복원하는 영상을 띄워 주길래 그걸 끝까지 다 봤지. 그리고 또 하나 더 봤고. 고개 들어 보니까 12시 45분이더라. 나 트레일러에 관심도 없는데. 참고로 건조기는 아직 고장 나 있어.
sentences.text: I sat down to look up how to fix the dryer, and I actually found it, but then YouTube showed me some guy restoring an old trailer and I watched the entire thing. And then another one. When I looked up it was quarter to one, and I don't even care about trailers. The dryer's still broken, by the way.

alts.text: So I got on my laptop to figure out the dryer, and I actually found it, but then YouTube hit me with some guy restoring an old trailer and I watched the whole thing. Then another one. Next time I looked up it was quarter to one, and I don't even care about trailers. Dryer's still broken, by the way.

I sat down to research how to repair the dryer, and I did find the answer, but then YouTube showed me a man restoring an old trailer and I watched all of it. Then another one after that. When I looked up it was quarter to one, and I have no interest in trailers at all. The dryer is still broken, incidentally.

sentences.note: **quarter to one** 은 한 시가 되기 십오 분 전, 즉 12시 45분입니다. **by the way** 는 하던 말 끝에 덧붙일 때 쓰는 참고로, 그나저나.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 이번 주 내내 잘하고 있었어, 진짜 잘하고 있었다니까. 근데 목요일에 누가 도넛을 사 왔고, 나는 반 개만 먹어야지 했지. 어떻게 됐는지는 말 안 해도 알지. 그래서 월요일부터 다시 시작하려고. 근데 이게 벌써 세 번째 월요일이라, 이쯤 되면 월요일에 다시 시작하는 방법이 안 먹힌다는 걸 인정해야지.
sentences.text: I was doing great all week, I really was, but then somebody brought donuts in on Thursday and I told myself I'd have half of one. You know exactly how that went. So now I'm starting over Monday, except that's the third Monday in a row, so at some point I have to admit the Monday thing isn't working.

alts.text: Honestly I was killing it all week, I really was, and then somebody brought donuts in on Thursday and I told myself just half of one. You know how that went. So now I'm starting over Monday, except that's three Mondays in a row, so at some point I gotta admit the Monday thing isn't working.

I was doing very well all week, I genuinely was, but then someone brought donuts in on Thursday and I told myself I would have half of one. You know precisely how that turned out. So now I am starting over on Monday, except that is the third Monday in a row, so at some point I must admit that the Monday approach is not working.

sentences.note: **You know exactly how that went** 은 결과가 뻔하니 말 안 해도 알지라는 뜻입니다. **in a row** 는 연달아, 연속으로.

sentences.ko: 솔직한 대답 듣고 싶어, 듣기 좋은 대답 듣고 싶어? 그래, 너한테 잘 어울려. 근데 네가 이미 갖고 있는 셔츠랑 초록색이 똑같아서, 결국 둘 중에 깨끗한 걸로 집어 입게 될걸. 그거 아직 반품돼? 나 같으면 아직 없는 색으로 살 것 같아.
sentences.text: Do you want the real answer or the nice one? Okay, it looks good on you, but it's the same green as the shirt you already have, so you're just going to grab whichever one's clean. Can you still take it back? Because if it were me I'd get it in a color you don't have yet.

alts.text: Honest answer or nice one? Okay, it looks good on you, but it's the same green as that shirt you've already got, so you're just gonna grab whichever one's clean. Can you still take it back? Because if it were me I'd get it in a color you don't have yet.

Would you prefer the honest answer or the polite one? It does look good on you, but it is the same green as the shirt you already own, so you will simply wear whichever one is clean. Are you still able to return it? If it were me, I would get it in a color you do not have yet.

sentences.note: **take it back** 은 산 물건을 가게에 도로 가져가 반품한다는 뜻입니다. **if it were me** 는 나라면 이렇게 하겠다고 할 때 쓰는 가정법.
sentences.situation: 친구가 산 옷 어떠냐고 물었을 때 솔직하게 말하기

sentences.ko: 윗집 남자가 책상을 옮겼나 봐. 요즘 열한 시부터 두 시까지 내 방 바로 위에서 의자를 앞뒤로 굴리거든. 한번 올라가 봤는데 그렇게 친절할 수가 없더라. 전혀 몰랐다고 하고. 그래 놓고 바로 그날 밤에 또 시작이야. 그래서 요즘은 선풍기 틀어 놓고 자는데, 뭘 떨어뜨리기 전까지는 대체로 괜찮아.
sentences.text: The guy upstairs moved his desk or something, because now he's rolling his chair back and forth over my bedroom from about eleven until two. I went up there once and he couldn't have been nicer about it, said he had no idea, and then that same night it started again. So I sleep with a fan on now, and it mostly works until he drops something.

alts.text: Upstairs guy moved his desk or something, because now he's rolling his chair back and forth over my bedroom from like eleven till two. I went up there once and he couldn't have been nicer about it, said he had no idea, and then that same night it started right back up. So I sleep with a fan on now, and it mostly works till he drops something.

The man upstairs must have moved his desk, because he now rolls his chair back and forth above my bedroom from about eleven until two. I went upstairs once and he could not have been more gracious about it, said he had no idea, and then that very night it began again. So I now sleep with a fan running, and it works for the most part until he drops something.

sentences.note: **he couldn't have been nicer** 는 더 친절할 수가 없을 만큼 친절했다는 뜻입니다. **it mostly works** 의 work 는 효과가 있다, 통한다는 뜻.

sentences.ko: 나갈 준비 다 했었어. 신발까지 현관에 꺼내 놓고 말이야. 근데 여동생한테 전화가 왔고 통화 끊고 나니까 거의 여섯 시 반이더라고. 지금 나가면 아홉 시나 돼야 밥을 먹거든. 그래서 그냥 안 가려고. 내일 아침에 출근 전에 갈래. 맨날 그 소리 하는 거 나도 알아.
sentences.text: I was all set to go, I had my shoes by the door and everything, but then my sister called and by the time we hung up it was almost six thirty. And if I leave now I'm not eating until nine, so I'm just skipping it. I'll go in the morning before work. I know I say that every time.

alts.text: I was ready to head out, shoes by the door and everything, and then my sister called and by the time we hung up it was almost six thirty. If I go now I'm not eating till nine, so I'm just bailing. I'll go in the morning before work. Yeah, I say that every time.

I was entirely prepared to go, I had my shoes by the door and everything, but then my sister called, and by the time we finished it was nearly six thirty. And if I leave now I will not eat until nine, so I have decided not to go this evening. I will go in the morning before work. I am aware that I say that every time.

sentences.note: **I was all set to go** 는 나갈 준비가 다 돼 있었다는 뜻입니다. **hung up** 은 전화를 끊다.
sentences.situation: 운동 가려다 말게 된 핑계 대기

reviewed: 5번 "I'm just calling it" 은 하던 일을 도중에 그만둘 때 쓰는 말이라, 아직 시작도 안 한 운동에는 안 맞습니다. "I'm just skipping it" 으로 바꿨습니다.
5번 note 가 없어진 표현(calling it)을 가르치고 있어서, 문장에 실제로 나오는 "I was all set to go" 를 짚도록 고쳤습니다.
5번 격식체의 "telephoned" 는 요즘 입으로는 안 쓰는 말이라 "called" 로 바꿨습니다.
5번 격식체 끝부분이 본문과 똑같아져서 "I have decided not to go this evening" 으로 달리 썼습니다.
1번 캐주얼의 "threw some guy ... at me" 는 목적어와 at me 사이가 멀어 읽을 때 걸립니다. "hit me with" 로 바꿨습니다.
1번 한국어 "한 시 십오 분 전" 이 어색해서 "12시 45분" 으로 바꿨습니다 (quarter to one 과 같은 시각이고 뜻풀이는 note 에 있습니다).
1번 한국어 끝줄 "고장 난 채야" 를 "아직 고장 나 있어" 로 다듬었습니다.
2번 한국어 "반 개만 먹자고 스스로 그랬지" 가 번역투라 "반 개만 먹어야지 했지" 로 바꿨습니다.
3번 한국어 마지막 줄이 "~살 것 같아서" 로 매달려 끝나서 "살 것 같아" 로 맺었습니다.
4번 격식체에 "and" 가 연달아 나와 하나 뺐습니다.
